summary.zh: 把分析结果讲成能推动决策的故事
summary.en: Turn analytics into a narrative that drives decisions.

description.zh: 用图表、背景和叙事结构把分析结果组织成有说服力的汇报，让结论对非技术受众也讲得通。做季度业务回顾、投资人材料或数据分析报告时使用。
description.en: Shapes charts, context and structure into a narrative that persuades. Use it for business reviews, investor decks and data reports aimed at non-technical audiences.
